title: Agni-P missile range
subject: Geography
caption: Illustration of the Agni‑P missile and its 1,000‑2,000 km range over India.
altText: A textbook-quality diagram on a white background showing the map of India with a realistic rendering of the Agni‑P missile at its launch point. Two concentric circles surround the missile, the inner circle labeled '1,000 km' and the outer circle labeled '2,000 km', indicating the missile's range. Major cities such as New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai are marked, as are state borders and the coastline. A legend in the lower right explains the missile icon and range rings. The illustration is high resolution, accurate, and clearly labelled for educational use.
